quotes.text: I can lower my fees a little bit, still make some money, not as much as I normally would, but I'd like for you to do three or four jobs with me.
I don't ever walk into a new relationship with a GC thinking it's adversarial. I want to be a good partner with them. I want to be treated well, just like I would want to be treated.
When the subs are running the job instead of the GC, that's where you get into lots of problems. The GC's got to drive the job and focus people in the areas they need to be in.
